name: Features 11
description: Pinned two-panel scroll story. Left panel crossfades 7 feature slides with per-word stagger and a lerped tab strip; right panel wipes media layers up as you scroll an 810vh track.
interactions: section pins for 810vh; scroll progress drives everything via rAF + scroll listener
media layers wipe up with cubic ease-out translateY((1-e)*100%)
text slides crossfade; body words fade in with seeded random stagger
tab strip lerps horizontally (x += (target-x)*0.12); active tab fills via width-clipped dark copy
below 900px: unpins, media panel hidden, slides stack
